changelog:
- Initial release: version 1.0.0 of the trendex-onedrive skill.
- Provides command-line tools to read, manage, upload, download, and share OneDrive and SharePoint files via the Microsoft Graph API.
- Supports both automated and manual setup with Azure, including App Registration and required permissions.
- Features coverage for file browsing, uploads, downloads, sharing (links and invites), inspecting metadata, permissions management, drive/SharePoint targeting, and token management.
- Allows use of existing Microsoft Graph tokens and flexible authentication methods.
- Includes detailed usage documentation and example outputs for all major actions.
summary: Read, manage, share, upload, and download OneDrive files via Microsoft Graph API. Use when the user asks about OneDrive, OneDrive for Business, SharePoint do...
